property_summary: Calling transfer with a valid caller and a non-empty array reverts in the buggy version due to require(false), while the reference succeeds. This test pranks the authorized caller 0x9797055B68C5DadDE6b3c7d5D80C9CFE2eecE6c9 and passes a single-element array, then asserts that the call returns true (reference) vs false (bug).
